symbols.name: digit width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each digit, a positive integer.

symbols.name: digit count
symbols.meaning: The number of digits in each input, the count of blocks of b bits.
symbols.quote: Let $m = \lceil n/b \rceil$ be the number of digits in each input.

symbols.name: digit position
symbols.meaning: The position of a digit in an input, running from 0 to m-1.
symbols.quote: Let $i$ be the position of a digit, running from $0$ to $m-1$.

symbols.name: digit of x
symbols.meaning: The digit of the first input x at position i, with weight (2^b)^i.
symbols.quote: Let $x_i$ be the digit of $x$ at position $i$, with weight $(2^b)^i$, so that $x = \sum_{i=0}^{m-1} x_i (2^b)^i$.

symbols.name: formal variable
symbols.meaning: A formal variable in which each input is written as a polynomial.

symbols.name: product coefficient position
symbols.meaning: The position of a coefficient of the product polynomial, running from 0 to 2m-2.
symbols.quote: Let $t$ be the position of a product coefficient, running from $0$ to $2m-2$.

symbols.name: product coefficient
symbols.meaning: The integer coefficient of z^t in the product of the two digit polynomials.
symbols.quote: Let $c_t$ be the integer coefficient of $z^t$ in the product $X(z)Y(z)$.

relations.quote: Radix-digit convolution is a reduction of [exact integer multiplication](exact-integer-multiplication.md) that writes each input as a polynomial in a power of two whose coefficients are its digits, so that the product becomes a convolution of short integer coefficients.
